items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I had Big Jim, Bill Matthews, Little Jim, Cindy Brown.

ctx.x: I had Big Jim, Bill Matthews, Little Jim, Cindy Brown. I had Louis the Man, Old Man Allen, Trumpet. I had Arthur Hogan, John Baptiste.

items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: I remember some times you'd be with the people like uh, Kid Howard, Matthew Williams, and they organized bands.

ctx.x: And uh, then I started out with this making street parades and I had more work than I could handle. Which bands did you play with? I played with all of the bands around here. That's uh, I played with the Tuxedo. That's John Kazmi. And uh, George William. He had a good brass band at the time. Oh man, there's so many old brass bands at the time. Some bands didn't have no name.

That's right, I remember some of the bands. That's right, I remember some of the bands that get up the group. Yeah. I remember some times you'd be with the people like uh, Kid Howard, Matthew Williams, and they organized bands. Yeah, that's right. And they organized bands. Yeah. And George Lewis.

Just get up a band. Just say, well we'll get up a bunch of fellas and make bands. See, no name. Yeah. Well, that was it. And it went a little further. And the road got so bad of playing on the road. Going out. Making night here and night there and the night next place. That was with Sam Morgan band, you name it? Yeah. Well, we used to go, when I was with Sam Morgan band, we used to go Pensacola, Mobile, Bloxy, Gulfport, and Hattiesbury. Then we'd come on back in town, you see? Mm-hmm. And we'd have a Saturday…
